scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:knip && npm run lint:deadcode
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run lint:all && npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:formal && npm run test:fuzz && npm run test:e2e
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -s first -n vite,electron "vite --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on -t 30000 tcp:localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.electron:start: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:smoke: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/smoke-test.ts
